status: experimental (2026-10-17, branch test/x470-98se-qemu): the release binary in test builds since then; installer/cmd/usos-efisign/release.go stages it with the source archive, the eleven patches (0001-0010, 0012) and the licence notices; tools/xp_csmwrap_esp.sh and the BIOS Core DOS installer pin its hash
naming: 3.1.2-usos11 = 3.1.2-usos10 without patch 0011 (the diagnostic KeTickCount watcher, kept in 3.1.2-usos10/patches as history) + patch 0012 (HPET and AMD GPIO hidden from Windows 2000 in the legacy DSDT/SSDT copies). Earlier: usos10 = usos9 + patch 0011 (read-only KeTickCount watcher on the BIOS helper core, Windows 2000 ACPI flow only), usos9 = usos8 + patch 0010 (SeaBIOS NVMe runtime re-arm after an OS stopped the controller, FUA writes after a re-arm), usos8 = usos7 + patch 0009 (APM power-off order ACPI mode -> status clear -> S5 -> helper ResetSystem last, bounded waits, CMOS breadcrumbs), usos7 = usos6 + patch 0008 (APM power-off from every APM interface, SeaBIOS serial debug output), usos6 = usos5 + patch 0007 (diagnostic ACPI enable before the legacy boot, Windows 2000 ACPI flow only), usos5 = usos4 + patch 0006 (ACPI 1.0 view), usos4 = usos3 + patch 0005, usos3 = usos1 + patch 0004.
modified: MODIFIED version of CSMWrap 3.1.2 and of its SeaBIOS fork: quiet boot unless csmwrap.ini sets verbose = true (patches 0001-0003, as in 3.1.2-usos1), and SeaBIOS CSM boot priorities looked up in CSMWrap's BBS table by PCI address, USB mass storage included (patch 0004, 2026-09-29); the exact disk CSMWrap was loaded from becomes BIOS drive 0x80 also when other disks share its controller (patch 0005, 2026-10-11: CSMWrap tags its BBS entry with an FNV-1a hash of its sector 0, SeaBIOS moves the matching hard disk first, the others keep their order); and an ACPI 1.0 view for legacy systems on CSMWrap's RSDP copy (patch 0006, 2026-10-13: RsdtAddress 0 / invalid RSDT / RSDT without the FACP or APIC the XSDT lists -> a new RSDT from the XSDT entries below 4 GiB; FADT 32-bit FIRMWARE_CTRL/DSDT/PM/GPE fields 0 with the X_ field set below 4 GiB -> a FADT copy with them filled, referenced from the RSDT only; csmwrap.ini acpi_legacy_fadt = true (written only for Windows 2000 with ACPI) -> the RSDT FADT is always a copy cut to revision 1 / 116 bytes, because the 2000 ACPI HALs copy FADT.Length bytes into a 0x84-byte buffer; with the same option the RSDT's DSDT/SSDTs are copies whose static resource templates have QWord windows above 4 GiB cleared, because the 2000 acpi.sys truncates a QWord Length to 32 bits and stops with STOP 0xA5 (0x2) in its PCI root window check; a valid 1.0 view without the option is left untouched; logged as "USOS ACPI10"); and, only with the same csmwrap.ini acpi_legacy_fadt = true, a legacy-to-ACPI-mode transition as the last step before Legacy16Boot (patch 0007, 2026-10-14, diagnostic: RTC A/B read, FADT ACPI_ENABLE written to SMI_CMD when PM1a_CNT.SCI_EN is 0, SCI_EN polled for at most 3 s on the PM timer, RTC A/B read again; 8 result bytes at physical 0x4F4 (BDA inter-application communication area) for usosvid; logged as "USOS ACPIEN"); and APM power-off that works from every APM interface (patch 0008, 2026-10-15: 5307h BX=0001h CX=0003h first asks the helper core for UEFI ResetSystem(EfiResetShutdown) through the bios_proxy mailbox with a 2 s timeout - from real/V86 mode with %es = F000h, from the 32-bit protected-mode interface through %gs instead of the real-mode segment loads that faulted there - then writes ACPI S5 directly: SLP_TYPa/b read from Name(_S5) in the DSDT/SSDT (X470: 5 -> PM1a_CNT 0x3400; QEMU: 0), PM1a and PM1b, SLP_EN last; still on after 2 s with SCI_EN = 0: FADT ACPI_ENABLE to SMI_CMD and S5 again; still on: the call returns AH=60h instead of halting; the 16-bit PM interface goes straight to the S5 write; _PTS is not run; result bytes at BDA 4FCh-4FFh for INT 15h callers, logged as "USOS APMOFF"; SeaBIOS dprintf level 1 goes to csmwrap.ini serial_port when serial = true, through CsmwrapFlags bit 0x02 and the new CsmwrapSerialPort field; the SeaBIOS layout keeps at least 6144 bytes of F-segment allocation space, upstream minimum 2048, because the code no longer leaves free room in the F-segment; and a new APM power-off order with a record of every step (patch 0009, 2026-10-15, after Windows 98 SE on the X470 hung on its shutdown screen with usos7): 1. SCI_EN = 0 -> FADT ACPI_ENABLE to SMI_CMD, SCI_EN polled for at most 1 s; 2. PM1a_EVT and GPE0 status bits cleared, all their enables 0; 3. S5 (SLP_TYP from _S5, SLP_EN last), 2 s wait; 4. still on, INT 15h and 32-bit PM only: the helper-core UEFI ResetSystem (2 s timeout) as the last resort; 5. AH=60h; every wait bounded by the PM timer and a spin count; every step recorded in the CMOS RTC alarm bytes 01h/03h/05h as a valid alarm time (seconds 40 + step, minutes path * 15 + call count, hours 1 + APM function bitmap; armed 40/0/1 when CSMWrap starts SeaBIOS) because edk2 PcRtcInit resets an invalid alarm at every boot, and on port 80h as A0h | step; the USOS UEFI menu appends the record to EFI\USOS\Logs\apm-off.txt and writes 00:00:00 back; and SeaBIOS NVMe INT 13h that survives an OS driver stopping the controller (patch 0010, 2026-10-15, after Windows 98 SE on the X470 NVMe stopped at "It's now safe to turn off your computer": usosnvme.mpd rebuilds the admin queue in its own memory and sends CC.SHN + CC.EN = 0 on the exit to real mode, so WIN.COM /z could not be read for the APM power-off): before every read/write BAR 0 is read from PCI config space (a 64-bit BAR above 4 GiB is refused); a controller that is enabled, ready, not shutting down and runs SeaBIOS's admin queue is used as it is; enabled with another admin queue = a live OS driver, refused at once; otherwise memory + bus master on, CC = 0, the admin queue and I/O queue pair 1 cleared and re-created in the POST memory (no runtime allocation), logged as "USOS NVME"; writes after a re-arm carry FUA; and, only with csmwrap.ini acpi_legacy_fadt = true, a read-only diagnostic watcher on the hidden BIOS helper core (patch 0011, 2026-10-15, written by Codex and reviewed for USOS, after Windows 2000 SP4 with the ACPI HAL on the X470 stopped after kernel phase 1 with no heartbeat): FADT PM1a_EVT/PM1a_CNT/PM_TMR/GPE0 ports, TSC calibrated on the PM timer, one EfiReservedMemoryType page below 4 GiB that must be type 2 in the E820 map SeaBIOS gets, its address handed to the helper through a private trampoline dword and to BDA 4FCh-4FFh right before Legacy16Boot (the APM power-off record of patch 0008 uses the same bytes only at an INT 15h power-off, which the 2000 ACPI HAL never calls); the helper keeps serving the bios_proxy mailbox first, uses PAUSE + RDTSC instead of MWAIT and about once a second reads KeTickCount and KUSER_SHARED_DATA InterruptTime (physical addresses published by usosvid 1.3), PM1 STS/EN/CNT, GPE0 STS/EN and the PIC IMRs, and writes them to its page range 100h-1FFh and as one 80-column line on VGA text row 24; no port writes, no CMOS, IOAPIC or LAPIC access, logged as "USOS WATCH"); not in usos11: patch 0011 (the watcher) was dropped from the series; and, only with the same csmwrap.ini acpi_legacy_fadt = true, HPET and AMD GPIO devices hidden from Windows 2000 (patch 0012, 2026-10-17, after the X470 diagnosis found the 2000 SP4 acpi.sys page-faulting in its early boot IRQ arbitration for the HPET and, with that hidden, for the GPIO controller _SB.GPIO, IRQ 7): in the private DSDT/SSDT copies of patch 0006 a Device with a flat TermList (NameOp/MethodOp only), exactly one _HID and one _STA, whose _HID or a _CID entry is PNP0103, AMDI0030 or AMD0030 (string or EISA ID integer, _CID also as a Package), gets a _STA that returns 0 (Name -> Zero, method body -> Return (Zero) + Noop), in place, lengths and resources unchanged; dry run on the firmware table first (valid checksum only, a malformed PkgLength makes the whole table count 0), the copy must give the same result; firmware tables and the XSDT view unchanged; logged as "USOS W2KHIDE")
